text:
maya: Follow-up from the Lyra dedicated postmortem. TL;DR: tenant isolation briefly failed during a maintenance failover due to stale conntrack entries on Lyra's on-prem NAT + a fast re-advertise from their peering causing a brief asymmetric path. Need owners for remediation, CI validation, monitoring, and customer coordination. Assigning below.

oliver: I'll own route-side fixes. Plan: add a 25s re-announce suppress, tighten export filters for Lyra prefixes, and add route-prop de-dupe logic. I'll open a PR and a rollback snippet. ETA: PR by Wed EOD.

renee: I'll run the on-prem audit with Lyra ops. Checklist: conntrack dump, NAT settings, kernel/firmware versions, and iptables state. If vendor firmware is implicated we'll request a patch timeline and propose a short-term CT pruning shim. Need maintenance window from Lyra.

kai: I'll add CI tests and a small chaos job in blueprints that simulates conntrack churn plus asymmetric path. Will mock Lyra's appliance to avoid touching production. ETA: test branch in 6 days.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INC-5444 "Lyra peering / conntrack investigation"  assignee: net-ops  https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5444

maya: Monitoring ask: create a dashboard and alerts for route_flap_rate, conntrack_reassoc_ratio, and dup_forwarded_packets. Alert triggers: route_flap_rate > 3/5m OR conntrack_reassoc_ratio > 0.6% OR dup_forwarded_packets > 0.05% in 5m. @oliver can you add the Grafana panel + alert?

oliver: Sure. Draft queries: sum(rate(route_flap_total{customer="lyra"}[5m])) by (peer) and sum(rate(conntrack_reassoc_total{customer="lyra"}[5m])) / max(1, sum(rate(conntrack_total{customer="lyra"}[5m]))) . Will wire slack alerts to #incidents and page on critical.

renee: FYI Lyra runs mixed firmware; one appliance is EOL and vendor response time may be slow. I'll add mitigation options to INC-5444 (pruner shim, route-holdback) and request a vendor RFO.

maya: Action summary added to postmortem doc: 1) oliver - route suppress + export filter + alerting (PR -> #PR-1150) ETA Wed EOD; 2) renee - on-prem audit + vendor escalation (INC-5444) ETA Mon next week; 3) kai - CI/blueprints e2e & chaos job ETA Fri next week; 4) customer coordination (owner: renee/vika) ETA tomorrow. Reconvene Tue 09:00 PT for a 15m check-in. Please update INC-5444 with milestones and paste PR/test links as they land. :white_check_mark:
